summary: Verified bug fix for legacy vendors with missing/undefined step in localStorage. Seeded a vendor without step field via localStorage, then ran full workflow via Playwright on preview URL.
tests_executed: Legacy vendor (no step field) displays 'Step 1' in Vendors Data Sheet (not 'Step undefined') - PASS
getVendors() auto-normalization persists step=1 to localStorage - PASS (verified via localStorage read)
Load button loads legacy vendor into form with correct tempRefId - PASS
Submit button (not disabled) advances Step 1 -> Step 2 - PASS (status: 'Step 2: Checking & Verification')
Final Approval advances Step 2 -> Step 3 and generates vendor code AE0001JV2627 - PASS
Data Sheet row updates to show 'Approved' with vendor code after approval - PASS
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In VendorRegistration.jsx handleSubmit uses vendor.checkedByName.trim() without optional chaining — could throw if checkedByName is undefined on legacy vendors. Same for approvedByName in handleApprove. Consider (vendor.checkedByName || '').trim() to be defensive.

TopActionBar disabled prop uses `![1, undefined, null].includes(vendor.step)` for submit — works but coupling undefined/null to enabled state is a code smell now that store normalizes step. After normalization, simple `vendor.step !== 1` would suffice.
seed_data_creation: Seeded ae_vm_auth, ae_vm_users, and ae_vm_vendors (with one legacy vendor id=legacy1, no step field) via page.evaluate before navigation to /vendor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix confirmed end-to-end. Approval banner and Rev badge regression not explicitly re-tested but code path exercised via handleApprove. Vendor Code format AE<4digits>JV<FY> validated with regex.
